mapper.select: select DATE_FORMAT(order_info.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS orderDate, SUM(order_info.total_amount) AS totalAmount, COUNT(order_info.id) AS totalNum from order_info where DATE_FORMAT(order_info.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')=#{createDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_info.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
